title: Workspace switching edge cases and UX

questions.prompt: When switching workspaces mid-conversation, should the UI prompt for confirmation before restarting the server (since the current session will end)?
questions.description: Switching workspaces restarts the OpenCode server, so any unsaved conversation context in the current session will be lost. Sessions from the previous workspace are preserved and available when switching back.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, show a confirmation dialog: 'Switch workspace? This will end your current conversation. Your sessions for this workspace will be available when you switch back.'

questions.prompt: What should happen if the workspace directory no longer exists (deleted/moved after it was added)?
questions.description: A workspace entry's folder path may become invalid if the user deletes or renames the directory outside of squid-chat.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Show an error in the UI with options to remove the workspace entry or re-select a new path for it

questions.prompt: How should the UI handle the brief downtime during workspace switch (server restart)?
questions.description: When switching workspaces, the server restarts — this takes ~1-3 seconds. The browser tab reconnects to the new instance.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Show a 'Reconnecting…' overlay with a subtle animation; auto-reconnect when the new server is ready

options.label: Show a toast notification, user clicks to reconnect
